name: Freedom to Ruul
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Eh?  Who are you?

adventurer?  You're no furbolg.  They are cursed!  They thought I was a bear and captured me, and now they starve me!  My strength is failing...

Help me escape, then speak with my sister Yama at the Splintertree Post to the east.

adventurer! I must escape!
narrative.objectives: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You found my brother!  He was captured by the Thistlefurs?  That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.

Thank you for rescuing my brother, adventurer.  I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul.  He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you seen my brother Ruul? He walked into the forest days ago and has not returned...
